points.description: First correct factor from the model answer list, named precisely: climatic conditions; geography of the region; extent of industrialization; quality of lifestyle; quality of water available; population of area.
Second distinct correct factor from the model answer list, named precisely.
Third distinct correct factor from the model answer list, named precisely.
Fourth distinct correct factor from the model answer list, named precisely.

rubric.notes: Exactly four factors are asked for; each must match one of the six in the model answer (climate, geography, industrialization, lifestyle, water quality, population) with the correct term. Vague items (e.g. "weather", "people", "cost") or wrong factors earn nothing for that point, and a wrong extra item beyond the four costs a point. Duplicates count once.
